run_ocr_action: run the OCR action to extract text boxes with bounding boxes from an image using a vision-language model
create_textbox_schema: create a TextBox schema with text and bounding box coordinates for OCR output
load_vlm_model: load the Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct vision-language model and processor for OCR inference
configure_ocr_schema: configure an ActionSchema that accepts PNG images and outputs text boxes with bounding box coordinates
stream_ocr_output: stream OCR results from the vision-language model and parse JSON text boxes asynchronously
